goal: Prevent RPC and REST lookups from falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing on disk read errors
Surface index corruption and storage I/O failures promptly to callers rather than returning empty results
agreement: Broad agreement on distinguishing missing transactions from internal read failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Objection that pruned block lookups returned I/O errors was resolved with availability checks (yuvicc)
Approval without detailed technical feedback (enirox001, furszy, sedited)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because returning empty results on read failures masked index corruption from callers
Early error surfacing protects node operators from treating damaged indexes as healthy

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC clients received misleading missing-transaction errors during disk read failures
Accurately distinguishes pruned or downloading blocks from missing data for downstream automation
